example.title: John Frydrych farmstead, barn
example.place: Tyndall vicinity, Bon Homme County, SD

brief: Very long gable-roofed stock barn about 36 ft wide and 100 ft long whose ground storey is a thick wall of grey and tan granite fieldstone with small square stall windows and doorways, topped by a frame upper storey of horizontal boards with a row of small windows, the white paint peeled almost to bare grey wood. The broad steep roof of dark asphalt shingle is sagging with a few holes, and a small louvered cupola with a pyramidal cap sits near one end. Black Angus cattle graze the fenced pasture in front; big elms and cottonwoods shelter the farmstead behind. (Stone-walled stock barn; nearest vocabulary type is bank_barn.)
